VIDEO SCRIPT: AREA
Grade: PP2 · Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES

[0:00–0:20] HOOK
• Host: “Today we learn Area. Watch the example, then you try.”

[0:20–2:00] TEACH
• Area = space covered.
• Rectangle: L × W.
• Square: side × side.
• Use cm² or m².

[2:00–4:00] WORKED EXAMPLE ON SCREEN
• 18 × 13 = 234 cm²
• 15 × 15 = 225 cm²
• 9 × 6 = 54 m²

[4:00–5:00] TRY THIS (PAUSE)
• Find area: 12 cm by 5 cm rectangle.
• Find area: square side 9 cm.
• Word problem: A rectangular plot is 20 m by 15 m. Find its area.

[5:00–5:30] REMEMBER + CTA
• Recap 3 bullets. “Now open Revision Quiz for Area.”

— CBC Learn · Video Hub script aligned to lesson + revision
